newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL-After-hours activity grinds to halt.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL-After-hours activity grinds to halt.

text.p: Traders said after-hours activity grew quiet shortly after the markets closed, with no stocks moving significantly off their close.
The Dow industrials hit another record high, climbing to 6430, in a volatile day of trading.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 3,500 shares compared to 66,300 shares on Tuesday. Session two volume was 8,494,300 shares compared to 7,498,775 shares on Tuesday.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
